title: Promising to Undo Harm — Barnes v. Yahoo
shortTitle: Promising to Undo Harm — Barnes v. Yahoo
summary: A representative’s promise to address abusive false profiles raises a reliance claim distinct from an asserted negligent undertaking.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Apply each component of § 90: the content and clarity of the promise, expected and actual reliance, detriment, and the need to avoid injustice. The reported conclusion about the statutory bar is not proof that each state-law element is satisfied.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
